abstract: Creates one or many enriched GitHub issues for any ASOME project and adds them to the linked GitHub Project board with every field populated and verified by read-back. Enforces vertical slicing and traceability to the mapa operativo; recommends Sprint, Priority, milestone, dates and assignee from per-lane sprint load (reusing the asome-sprint capacity ceiling) and lets the user decide; detects duplicates; creates the [UX] twin with the needs:ux pointer; batch mode plans a whole set with running load totals and a single approval.
